import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.api import handle_import, handle_add
c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Old"})
r = handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": " A@B ", "name": " New "}, {"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}]})
assert r == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}, r
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "New"), ("x@y", "X")]
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
before = list_contacts(c)
bad = [[{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "N@n", "name": "M"}],
       [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "a@@b", "name": "M"}],
       [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, "x"],
       [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "q@q"}],
       [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "q@q", "name": " "}],
       [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N", "z": 1}]]
for b in bad:
    try: handle_import(c, {"contacts": b}); assert False, b
    except ValueError: pass
    assert list_contacts(c) == before
for p in [None, [], {}, {"contacts": "x"}, {"contacts": [], "x": 1}]:
    try: handle_import(c, p); assert False
    except ValueError: pass
# db failure rollback
c.execute("CREATE TRIGGER t BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email='boom@x' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'no'); END")
try: handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "ok@x", "name": "O"}, {"email": "boom@x", "name": "B"}]}); assert False
except sqlite3.DatabaseError: pass
assert list_contacts(c) == before
print("ok")
